guitar.notes: Ted Nugent's Gibson Byrdland is well documented as his signature stage instrument, distinctive among rock guitarists of his era.

tone.target: wide 70s hard-rock crunch with wah lead and thick sustain
tone.profile: wide 70s hard-rock crunch with wah lead and thick sustain
tone.summary: A classic hard-rock chain utilizing a Blues OD boost for grit, Distortion for crunch, a Wah pedal for lead sweeps, followed by the UK 45 amp model and UK Vintage 4x12 cab to achieve thick, biting 70s rock tones.
corrections: keep it more 70s crunch than high-gain
